name: Generic MIDI capture
description: Works with any firmware: a list of CC values, each with its channel, plus optional raw SysEx messages and a program number. Capture it from Play & MIDI's CC discovery or write it by hand. Only standard MIDI is sent; what the firmware does with it is up to the firmware.

capture.name: MIDI CC capture
capture.description: Sent in order: Program Change, then each CC, then each SysEx message.

fields.cc: array of {"ch": 1-16 (optional, default: the note channel), "cc": 0-127, "value": 0-127}
fields.sysex: array of hex strings, one complete message each, e.g. "F0 7D 01 02 F7"
